rules.note: Clear scan of the home page of your ordinary passport, valid beyond 1 September 2027. Diplomatic and service passports are not accepted.
Not listed in the official requirements. (The physical examination form carries a sealed photo.)
Notarised photocopy of your highest diploma. If you have not graduated yet, official proof of student status. Other languages need a notarised English or Chinese translation.
Academic transcripts. Other languages need a notarised English or Chinese translation.
A language certificate for your programme: IELTS/TOEFL or the UNESCO Certificate of Language Knowledge for English-taught, valid HSK for Chinese-taught programmes.
For English-taught programmes: IELTS or TOEFL. Without one, a UNESCO Certificate of Language Knowledge (Annex IV) signed and stamped by a certified language institution or tutor.
Only for Chinese-taught programmes: a valid HSK report that meets your programme's level (HSK 4 for degree programmes).
A pre-admission document from the Chinese university you apply to (admission notice, pre-admission letter or invitation from a professor).
Study plan or research proposal in Chinese or English: at least 800 words for a degree programme, at least 500 words for a one-year visiting programme.
Two letters in Chinese or English from professors or associate professors who know your work or studies.
Two letters in Chinese or English from professors or associate professors who know your work or studies.
Two letters are required for degree programmes and senior visiting scholars only.
Foreigner Physical Examination Form (Annex III) in English, complete, signed by the doctor, stamped by the hospital and with a sealed photo. Valid for 6 months.
Certificate of non-criminal record from your local public security authority, issued within 6 months of the application deadline.
Only for art or design fields: examples of your own work.
Only if you are under 18: valid documents of your legal guardian in China.
Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship, printed after you finish the online application (agency number 00001, Type A). Your National Commission for UNESCO must nominate you.
